newsitem.title: UK: Lehman appoints head of tax derivative stucturing.
newsitem.headline: Lehman appoints head of tax derivative stucturing.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday Jos Corswarem was to join the bank as director and head of tax derivative structuring.
"In this role, Corswarem will be responsible for the development of tax efficient products for institutional clients in Europe and the Middle East," Lehman said in a statement.
It said Corswarem would report to Alex Abadie, head of derivative sales and structuring.
Corswarem will join Lehman from Citibank where he spent the last seven years in a variety of functions in derivatives and corporate finance, the bank said.
